result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual, agreement-wide cap using the preferred greater-of formula and includes all specified uncapped carve-outs, while leaving the existing indemnity language unchanged and excluding Client payment obligations from the cap. It therefore exceeds the fallback requirements, although it does not fully achieve the preferred position because it omits a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. The drafting is generally professional, with minor imprecision in defining Excluded Claims and use of the period preceding the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself.
